get.summary: List entries a consumer group has not acknowledged

parameters.name: X-User-Id

schema.description: Operator ID; required for writes and recorded as created_by/updated_by.
schema.title: X-User-Id

parameters.description: Operator ID; required for writes and recorded as created_by/updated_by.

lag.title: Lag
lag.description: Entries not yet delivered to the group; null when Redis cannot tell, such as after entries were deleted.

last_delivered.description: Null when the group has read nothing.

idle_ms.title: Idle Ms
idle_ms.description: Since its last attempt to read.

inactive_ms.title: Inactive Ms
inactive_ms.description: Since its last successful read or claim.

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as `before` for older entries; null at the Stream's start.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: Parsed JSON, or the stored text when it is not JSON.

EventStreamEntryResponse.title: EventStreamEntryResponse
EventStreamEntryResponse.description: One entry as stored; fields a broken entry lacks are null.

retention_seconds.title: Retention Seconds
retention_seconds.description: Entries older than this are trimmed.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Approximate per-Stream cap; null when unset.

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: False when Redis holds no Stream for the tenant.

entries_added.title: Entries Added
entries_added.description: Entries ever written, including trimmed ones.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Caller-owned identifiers such as batch or run IDs, stored as given and echoed in execution.completed. At most 32 keys matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$, 4096 serialized bytes.

FinalizedBy.title: FinalizedBy
FinalizedBy.description: What ended a MULTI Execution, or any Execution past its lifetime.

KernelUsageResponse.title: KernelUsageResponse
KernelUsageResponse.description:
A running kernel now: its process and the processes it started.

Memory is resident set size (RSS); pages shared with forked children
count once per process. CPU seconds count from the kernel's start.

path.title: Path
path.description: Input file path relative to STORAGE_ROOT; no prefix is added.

path.title: Path
path.description: Python file path relative to STORAGE_ROOT; no prefix is added.

execution_id.title: Execution Id
execution_id.description: Null, like the next two, once the entry was trimmed.

RecordedStepUsageResponse.title: RecordedStepUsageResponse
RecordedStepUsageResponse.description: Measured Step attempts of the Execution, over all its attempts.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port Executor talks to; under Sentinel, the current master.

StatusReasonCode.title: StatusReasonCode
StatusReasonCode.description:
Why an Execution is in its status, where no other enum says so.

A FAILED Execution's reason is its FailureType, and one ended by
finalization or the maximum runtime carries its FinalizedBy.

code.title: Code
code.description: A FailureType for FAILED; AGENT, WAIT_TIMEOUT or MAX_RUNTIME for an Execution ended by finalization or its maximum runtime; otherwise a status-specific code such as CAPACITY_FULL for QUEUED.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Values behind the code: queue_position and per-Target targets for QUEUED, handover_reason and paused_since for WORKER_HANDOVER. Null when the code needs none.

StatusReasonResponse.title: StatusReasonResponse
StatusReasonResponse.description: Why the resource is in its status.

StepResultReference.title: StepResultReference
StepResultReference.description: Immutable Step result manifest in the Agent/Executor shared volume.

StepUsageResponse.title: StepUsageResponse
StepUsageResponse.description:
The kernel's peak memory (RSS) and CPU time during this Step attempt.

Null when the Runtime did not measure it. The peak counts the kernel and
its child processes still running at the end of the Step.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the value came from (body or header), then its field path.

context.title: Context
context.description: The values behind the reason, such as limit and actual.

APIKeyHeader.description: Caller API key; required on every API call.
APIKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key
